thread:
Alice Chen: Quick design/consistency check — noticed the help sidecar in the Runtime dashboard says 'Guides' at the top but the links and in-product copy refer to 'Docs' and 'In-product Help'. Feels inconsistent. Screenshot attached: https://files.redwood.ai/snap/rt-sidecar.png :eyes: Ravi Patel: ugh yeah that mismatch is confusing, especially for new users. which label do we want to standardize on? 'Docs' or 'Help'? Maya Gomez: Prefer 'In-product help' or 'Help' — 'Docs' reads like full docs site. We use 'Docs' elsewhere for external docs though. docs-bot: Auto-link: Related doc page: https://docs.redwood.ai/console/help-sidecar (last updated 2025-11-02) Sam Irwin: From accessibility POV, we also need to ensure the sidecar has a meaningful aria-label and that the anchor links include skip-to-content semantics. Right now keyboard focus lands inside the panel but there's no skip link back to the main canvas. Jordan (UX): Agree with Maya: 'In-product help' clarifies scope. Proposal: change header to 'Help' and update all cross-links to show 'In-product help' in hover text. Keep the top-level nav on docs.redwood.ai as 'Docs'. Alice Chen: That sounds reasonable. Two follow-ups: 1) update the header copy + tooltip; 2) add an anchor link behavior so clicking a doc link opens the sidecar and scrolls to the subsection (preserve history so Back works). Ravi Patel: On the implementation side, a simple anchor hash sync should do it: when clicking /console?panel=help#kv-cache -> sidecar opens and locally scrolls to #kv-cache. Need to ensure this doesn't break existing deep links. Sam Irwin: Sample aria tweak for the panel wrapper:
. Also add Skip back to console at top of sidecar. Maya Gomez: Small copy nit: our Glossary uses 'KV cache' sometimes and 'prefix cache' elsewhere. Can we map synonyms in the sidecar search and add a small 'Also known as' line in the doc headers? Jordan (UX): Good call. I'll add microcopy: 'Also called: prefix/KV cache' under headings. Also will mock the header change. Alice Chen: Can someone open a tiny PR for: header text change, tooltip update, hash sync behavior, aria attributes, and the sr-only skip link? Keep changes behind a feature flag 'help-unify-23' so we can roll back if needed. Sam Irwin: I'll take the accessibility bits. Will include tests for keyboard tab order and focus return on close. Ravi Patel: I can wire up the hash->open logic and add URL history handling (pushState / replaceState). Will add an e2e test. Jordan (UX): I'll drop the mock in Figma and ping the docs writers for the glossary mapping. Alice Chen: Awesome — thanks team. Can we aim to have the PRs by EOD Friday? :thumbsup: Maya Gomez: Yep, I'll coordinate with docs writers. docs-bot: Reminder: Please add a CHANGELOG entry if you touch sidecar behavior. Sam Irwin: noted. Ravi Patel: FYI I'll prefix commits with feat(help-sidecar): so QA can filter. Alice Chen: Perfect — moving to the #release-war-room checklist once merged. Thanks!
